title: Australian Toasted Bread
description: A simple Australian-style toasted bread recipe, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: Preheat a toaster or toaster oven to 350°F (180°C).
Place the bread slices in the toaster or oven and toast until lightly browned.
Meanwhile, toast the Australian toast until crispy.
Once the bread is toasted, spread a small amount of crunchy on top of each slice.
Place a slice of Australian toast on top of each bread slice.
